On to the bread making!

Ingredients for a loaf of bread

  • 1 pound of flour and extra half cup for kneading
  • 10 oz of warm water
  • 2 TSP salt
  • 1 1/2 TSP dry yeast

Notes on yeast:

There are many ways to make bread rise some better than others. Back in the day, you could buy yeast cakes from the local brewers. Yeast cultivation is a very important part of the alcohol industry. Sometimes yeast cakes would become prohibitively expensive. People also use homegrown yeast cultures, sour dough, and chemical reactions with baking soda or baking powder, salt and acid. All of these methods produce a different flavor. Dry packaged yeast is what is commonly available these days and will produce a flavor most find acceptable. Of commonly available yeast brands, I find red star performs the best.
